title: 11 Best Herbal Creams For Shingles
description: Mentha x piperita creams, derived from the peppermint plant, have been used to treat the shingles ailment due to their anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antiviral properties. The menthol present in these creams helps to reduce pain and itching associated with shingles, providing relief to the affected areas.
